models.name: todo_app_todo_statuses
models.description:
Catalogue of allowed Todo status values used across the todoApp service.

This table defines the normalized list of business-level statuses that a Todo item may take, such as active or completed. Each status has a stable code, human-readable label, and optional semantic grouping so that other components can distinguish minimal core states from future extended ones.

Other tables like `todo_app_todos` refer to these records via foreign keys to enforce that only configured statuses are used. Historical records continue to reference their original status rows even if a status is later deprecated, which is why soft deletion is supported instead of hard removal.

Administrative tools can manage which statuses are currently usable, what the default status is for new Todos, and the order in which statuses are presented in user interfaces.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies each Todo status entry.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Stable machine-readable status code such as "ACTIVE" or "COMPLETED". Used as business identifier across services and should not change once created.

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label for the status shown in user interfaces, such as "Active" or "Completed".

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional textual description that explains the meaning and intended usage of this status in business terms.

plainFields.name: group
plainFields.description: Optional semantic group name that can classify statuses, for example "core" for built-in states or a feature-specific group identifier.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Integer used to control display ordering of statuses in lists. Lower values are typically shown first.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this status is the default for new Todos when no explicit status is provided.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this status can currently be assigned to Todos. When false, status is treated as deprecated but historical references remain valid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the status is considered logically removed but kept for historical reference.

models.name: todo_app_system_configs
models.description:
Global configuration entries that control system-wide behavior of the todoApp service.

Each row represents a single configuration item identified by a combination of scope and key, with an associated value stored as text plus basic metadata. This design allows the platform to manage settings such as deletion model, retention periods, feature toggles, or other system-level options without modifying business tables.

Configuration entries can be grouped by scope (for example, "todo" or "auth"), can be activated or deprecated over time, and are tracked with temporal fields for audit. Application services read from this table at runtime to determine current behavior for cross-cutting concerns.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies each system configuration entry.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Logical namespace for this configuration entry, such as "todo", "auth", or "system". Used to group related keys.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Configuration key name within its scope, such as "deletion_model" or "soft_delete_retention_days".

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as text. The consuming service is responsible for parsing it into the appropriate type, such as boolean, integer, or JSON payload.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable description that explains the purpose and allowed values of this configuration entry.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this configuration entry is currently in effect. Inactive entries are retained for audit or rollback but should not influence runtime behavior.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the configuration entry is treated as logically removed while its history is kept.

models.name: todo_app_guestusers
models.description:
Guest user identity records for conceptual guestUser actors.

Represents minimal identity information for guest users when the system needs to persist a reference to an unauthenticated visitor, for example for analytics, trials, or future account upgrade flows. These records are not used for authentication but allow associating other data with a stable guest identifier.

Guest users do not own Todos directly in the current business scope, but the table is defined to satisfy the requirement that each actor type has a corresponding identity table within the Actors component.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the guest user identity.

plainFields.name: external_reference
plainFields.description: Optional external reference identifier for this guest user. Can be used to link to cookies, device identifiers, or external systems when needed.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable nickname or label for the guest user. Not used for authentication and may be empty.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the guest user record. Typical values include "active" for valid references and "archived" for no-longer-used entries.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user record was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_guestuser_sessions
models.description:
Session records for guestUser actors.

Represents authenticated or tracked sessions associated with guest users according to the standard session table pattern. Each row records contextual information about when and how a guest interacted with the system, including IP address and navigation URLs.

These sessions are subsidiary to {@link todo_app_guestusers} identities and are primarily used for audit, telemetry, or gradual upgrade of guests to registered users. They are not used for privileged authentication in the current scope.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the guest user session.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description: Guest user that this session belongs to. {@link todo_app_guestusers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the guest user accessed the service during this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL that the guest user initially accessed when this session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the guest user navigated from when the session started.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user session expired or was invalidated. Null while the session is still considered active.

models.name: todo_app_todousers
models.description:
Registered end-user accounts for todoUser actors.

Represents authenticated users who own and manage personal Todo items. Each row stores identity and credential data required for login, along with lifecycle status and basic metadata.

Todo users are the primary owners of business data in {@link todo_app_todos} and related tables. Administrative actors and authorization logic use this table to enforce per-user isolation of Todo data.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the todo user account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for this todo user. Used as the primary login identifier and for account-related communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for this todo user account. Stores only a secure password hash, never the plain-text password.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable display name for this todo user, shown in user interfaces or administrative views.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status for this todo user. Typical values include "active", "suspended", or "closed" according to account lifecycle rules.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user last successfully authenticated. Null if the user has never logged in.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo user account was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_todouser_sessions
models.description:
Authentication session records for todoUser actors.

Represents login sessions for registered todo users, capturing connection context and temporal boundaries. Each session is tied to exactly one todo user and may coexist with other sessions for the same user across devices.

These records enable auditing of user actions, support security features such as session invalidation, and help analyze login behavior without duplicating user identity data from {@link todo_app_todousers}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the todo user session.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Todo user that this session is associated with. {@link todo_app_todousers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the todo user accessed the service during this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL that the todo user initially accessed when starting this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the todo user navigated from when the session started.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo user session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo user session expired or was invalidated. Null while the session remains active.

models.name: todo_app_todoadmins
models.description:
Administrative user accounts for todoAdmin actors.

Represents internal operators with elevated privileges who can access and manage Todo and account data for support, troubleshooting, or policy enforcement. Each admin account stores credentials and lifecycle information distinct from regular todo users.

Administrative actions performed by these accounts are typically logged in {@link todo_app_todo_admin_audits} or related audit tables for accountability and compliance.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the todo admin account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for this administrative account. Used as the primary login identifier for todoAdmin actors.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for this administrative account. Stores only a secure password hash, never the plain-text password.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable display name for this administrator, used in dashboards and audit logs.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of this administrative account. Typical values include "active", "suspended", or "closed".

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account last successfully authenticated. Null if the admin has never logged in.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this administrative account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this administrative account record was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_todoadmin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication session records for todoAdmin actors.

Represents login sessions for administrative users, allowing the system to track when and from where administrators access the service. These sessions are critical for security auditing and for enforcing policies such as forced logout or session timeout.

Each session links to a single admin account in {@link todo_app_todoadmins} and records connection metadata without duplicating admin identity fields.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the todo admin session.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todoadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrative user that this session belongs to. {@link todo_app_todoadmins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrative user accessed the service during this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL that the administrative user initially accessed when starting this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the administrative user navigated from when the session started.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this administrative session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this administrative session expired or was invalidated. Null while the session remains active.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Todo items owned by individual todo users.

Represents the primary business entity for the todoApp domain, storing each actionable task that a todoUser wants to manage. Each record captures ownership, status, timing metadata, and optional due date while enforcing strict per-user data isolation through foreign keys.

The model references the todo user table for ownership and the todo status lookup for the current state (such as active or completed). It supports soft deletion via a nullable deleted_at timestamp so that items can be removed from normal views while remaining available for lifecycle and retention policies.

Administrative actors interact with these todos indirectly, typically via audit trails stored in {@link todo_app_todo_admin_audits}, without becoming owners of the todos themselves.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the todo item, generated as a UUID and immutable for the lifetime of the record.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo item. References the authenticated todo user account that exclusively owns and manages the todo. {@link todo_app_todousers.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_status_id
foreignFields.description: Current business status of the todo, such as active or completed. {@link todo_app_todo_statuses.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short text title describing the task. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character and obey business maximum length constraints to keep lists scannable.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer text providing additional details about the task. May be null or empty, subject to maximum length constraints defined by business rules.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo. Represents the target calendar date and time by which the user aims to complete the task. May be null when no due date is specified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was first created. Set once at creation time and never changed afterward, used for default sorting and audit context.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the todo, including content or status changes. Updated on every successful update operation.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo entered a completed state. Set when status transitions from active to completed and cleared when a previously completed todo is reactivated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the todo is considered deleted and must be excluded from normal user listings while remaining available for administrative or lifecycle processing.

models.name: todo_app_todo_admin_audits
models.description:
Administrative audit log entries for changes made by todo administrators to todo items.

Tracks who changed a todo, what was changed, and when the change occurred for administrative oversight and compliance. Each record links a single administrative action to the target todo and the acting admin, capturing high-level action type and optional field-level before and after values.

This table is append-only from a business perspective and is not directly managed by end users. It supports investigation of support actions, abuse handling, and policy enforcement without overloading the primary {@link todo_app_todos} model with audit-specific columns.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the administrative audit record, generated as a UUID.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Target todo item affected by the administrative action. {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todoadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrative user who performed the action on the todo. {@link todo_app_todoadmins.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Short code or label describing the type of administrative action, such as update, delete, restore, or status_change. Used for categorising audit entries.

plainFields.name: field_name
plainFields.description: Optional name of the field that was changed when the action targets a specific attribute, such as title or status. Null for actions that are not field-specific.

plainFields.name: previous_value
plainFields.description: Optional textual representation of the previous value before the administrative change. Used for understanding what state was overwritten. May be null for actions where a prior value is not applicable.

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: Optional textual representation of the new value after the administrative change. Helps reconstruct the resulting state after an action. May be null for deletions or actions without a new value.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional free-form explanation entered by the administrator to justify the action, such as policy enforcement, abuse handling, or support correction. Supports later review and auditability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative action occurred and this audit record was created. Used for chronological review of admin activity and todo history.
